article.title: Moving from the Outside, In: A Guide for Socialists Legislators
article.author: Paul Pinsky
article.content: The recent election victories of left candidates in New York and far beyond—many carrying the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) moniker—have captured national headlines. But the attendant excitement has left a key question unanswered: How can left candidates for high-profile mayoral and congressional offices best govern once they’ve been elected?
